svg.text: ExpressRoute Site Resiliency Tiers: Standard vs. Metro vs. Maximum
Single Peering Site A (Single-Facility Blast Radius)
Facility power/cooling/fiber outage drops BOTH links!
Loses all on-prem routes if Facility A fails
- Survives single router or single optic failure only
- Blocked in Portal where Metro is offered by provider
- Cost: 1x Circuit | Resiliency Index Route Score: 5%
1 Metro circuit split across 2 sites in same city
- Provider or ER Direct (10G/100G) across City + City2
- Survives full colocation facility outage at 1x circuit fee
- Vulnerable only to metro-wide regional disaster
- Prod Baseline | Route Score: 10% (no test mult.)
2 circuits in 2 geo-distinct metros + diverse carriers
Pin preferred metro via RoutingWeight + Local Pref
- Zero single point of failure across edge & metro
- Premium SKU required on BOTH if cross-geopolitical
- Cost: 2x Circuits | Route: 20% x 1x-4x Test = up to 80%
Max Resiliency Index (100%): Multi-Site Route (20% x 1x-4x Test) + AZ GW (10%) + Advisor (10%) | Std=5%, Metro=10% base
Azure Networking Field Architect Handbook | Part 3: Hybrid Connectivity
